application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details pursuant to conditions 7 (Landscape Plan), 9 (Details on fencing, walls and gateways) and 10 (Details on landscaping, parking, waste storage, cycle parking) of Full Planning Permission application reference 23/3600 dated 26/01/2024 for Proposed two-storey side to rear wrap-around extension, to create a 3-bedroom flat at ground-floor level, reduction of the existing ground-floor 4-bed 4- person HMO to a 3-bed 3-person HMO and enlargement of the existing upper-floor 5-bed 5- person HMO, erection of a single-storey detached outbuilding for communal gym with separate cycle storage in the rear garden and associated landscaping with refuse storage in the front forecourt.
